subject: Post-demo: model mix & token-volume q's / pricing follow-up
messages:

Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap — model mix & cost questions

Thanks for the demo earlier — super helpful. Quick follow-ups from our side as we prep budget: 

1) Token volumes: attached is our rough daily/weekly usage by feature (chat, embeddings, rerank). High level: ~30M chat tokens/month, 10M embedding tokens/month, 2M rerank tokens/month. I'll send a cleaned spreadsheet.
2) Budget: leadership flagged a target cost of <= $1,000 per 1M tokens across the portfolio as a ballpark — but they understand model mix will change that.
3) Models: we plan to run chat on a mix of a 8k-context chat model for user-facing flows and a cheaper 2k model for background tasks; embeddings will be primarily text-embedding-3-small equivalent; rerank is low volume but latency sensitive.

Can you confirm which model variants (and per-model unit pricing if available) you used in the demo and any recommended mixes to hit that $/1M target? Also include any quantization/throughput tradeoffs we should consider.

Thanks — attaching the rough workbook now (acme_token_estimates.xlsx).

Best,
Jesse
Director of Product
Acme Platform

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jesse Park <jesse.park@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap — model mix & cost questions

Jesse — great to get the workbook, thanks. Quick recap from our side and next steps: 

Summary of models used in demo:
- chat: Redwood-chat-8k (higher-quality, longer context) and Redwood-chat-2k (cost-optimized)
- embeddings: redwood-embed-small-v1
- rerank: redwood-rerank-lowlatency

Initial thought on unit economics (very high level):
- Redwood-chat-8k: ~$1,800 per 1M input+output tokens (hosted list price; can vary by quantization/throughput and Dedicated discounts)
- Redwood-chat-2k: ~$650 per 1M tokens
- redwood-embed-small-v1: ~$120 per 1M embeddings tokens (note embeddings are billed per unit depending on wording/seq length)
- rerank: priced per request; for your volume ~2M tokens would translate to a small fraction of total spend — estimate ~$200 per 1M equivalent tokens for rerank pipelines

To move toward your $1,000 / 1M target, two levers we recommend:
- Model mix: push bulk background/batch workloads to chat-2k and/or cached responses where possible
- Quantization & Dedicated: if you commit to Reserved (Dedicated) capacity, we can recommend int8 quantized variants that reduce unit cost materially (~25-40%)

Next steps I propose:
- Rishi (copied) will build a short unit-economics model using your workbook to show a few model-mix scenarios and expected $/1M tokens (we'll include Dedicated vs hosted tiers).
- I'll follow up with a formal pricing PDF and suggested mixes for low/medium/high quality.

Does a Friday sync (3/19) at 11:00 PT work for you to review the scenarios?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
612-555-0142

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jesse Park <jesse.park@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Chen <lydia.chen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap — model mix & cost questions

Jesse / team — I pulled your workbook and sketched three model-mix scenarios. High level findings (quick):

Scenario A — Quality-first:
- 80% chat volume on chat-8k, 20% on chat-2k
- embeddings & rerank unchanged
- Estimated blended cost: ~$1,460 per 1M tokens

Scenario B — Balanced (recommended starting point):
- 40% chat-8k, 60% chat-2k (move async/background tasks to 2k)
- embeddings: same; rerank: same
- Estimated blended cost: ~$860 per 1M tokens

Scenario C — Cost-first:
- 15% chat-8k, 85% chat-2k + batch caching for common prompts
- embeddings: migrate to quantized embed-small where feasible
- Estimated blended cost: ~$590 per 1M tokens

Assumptions I used are in the attached spreadsheet (I added a tab named 'RW_scenarios') and assume hosted list prices with a 20% assumed discount for multi-year commit; Dedicated pricing reduces unit further by ~30% in these mixes.

A few questions back to you to finalize the scenario that best matches: 
- Which user flows must remain on 8k (live user-facing vs admin-only)?
- Do you have any hard SLA/latency requirements for rerank that would block cheaper infra choices?

I'll join Friday's sync and walk through the workbook.

Best,
Rishi
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
(attachment: rdw_pricing_quote_v1.pdf)

From: Jesse Park <jesse.park@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Demo recap — model mix & cost questions

Thanks both — this is very helpful. Quick answers: 
- User flows that must stay on 8k: primary chat for logged-in users (support + product UX). Background/async assistants can be shifted to 2k. Expect ~55% of chat volume to be user-facing flows.
- Rerank latency: needs 200ms p95 or better for search experience; if that can't be met on quantized instances, we can keep rerank on dedicated low-latency nodes.

We'll review Rishi's scenarios on Friday. Please confirm you received the workbook edits — I uploaded a cleaned tab called 'ACME_final' to the same file. Also send the formal pricing PDF you mentioned.

Appreciate the quick turn — see you Friday at 11 PT.

Best,
Jesse
